Four Soldiers Die in Training Fire at CFB Wainwright

Four soldiers died in a fire during a military training exercise at Canadian Forces Base (CFB) Wainwright. The incident occurred during a training event, and the cause of the fire is under investigation. The province of Saskatchewan is honoring the fallen soldiers.
